detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(le.device_type) LIKE '%MOBILE%' 
AND UPPER(le.device_type) LIKE '%DESKTOP%' 
AND le.user_agent NOT LIKE '%%%' 
AND le.created_at >= date('now', '-1 hour') 
AND t.instrument IN ('CRYPTO', 'FOREX') 
AND u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND u.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM transactions GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(amount) * 1.3 > (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE user_id = transactions.user_id))
